import http.client
import json
import os

def test_post_without_or_with_empty_content_length_returns_411(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"content": "no length"}'
        for headers in ({}, {"Content-Length": ""}):
            with self.subTest(headers=headers):
                status, response_body = self.raw_request("POST", "/paste", headers, body)
                self.assertEqual(status, 411)
                self.assertIn(b"Content-Length required", response_body)

    def test_post_with_content_length_and_get_requests_work(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"content": "with length"}'
        status, response_body = self.raw_request(
            "POST",
            "/paste",
            {"Content-Length": str(len(body)), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
            body,
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        paste_id = json.loads(response_body)["id"]

        status, _ = self.raw_request("GET", "/health", {})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        status, response_body = self.raw_request("GET", f"/paste/{paste_id}", {})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(response_body), {"content": "with length"})
